scripts.lint: oxlint apps shared benchmark scripts compiler-activity --ignore-pattern 'benchmark/fixtures/**'
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @experiment/compiler typecheck && yarn workspace @experiment/manual typecheck && yarn workspace @experiment/baseline typecheck
scripts.build: yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build && yarn workspace @experiment/manual build && yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build
scripts.build:pages: PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/compiler/ yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build && PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/manual/ yarn workspace @experiment/manual build && PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/baseline/ yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build && yarn build:pages:profile && yarn test:compiler-repros && yarn test:compiler-activity && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs
scripts.build:pages:profile: PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/profile/compiler/ yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build:profile --outDir dist-profile-pages && PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/profile/manual/ yarn workspace @experiment/manual build:profile --outDir dist-profile-pages && PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/profile/baseline/ yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build:profile --outDir dist-profile-pages
scripts.build:profile: yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build:profile && yarn workspace @experiment/manual build:profile && yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build:profile
scripts.benchmark: yarn fmt:check && yarn lint && node scripts/check-guard.mjs && node --test benchmark/capture.test.mjs benchmark/load-memory.test.mjs scripts/report-evidence.test.mjs && yarn typecheck && yarn typecheck:measure && yarn typecheck:load-memory && node scripts/run-benchmark.mjs && node scripts/report.mjs && node --test scripts/report.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck:measure: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --jsx react-jsx --strict --skipLibCheck --types node,vite/client benchmark/measure.spec.ts benchmark/workspace.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck:load-memory: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --strict --skipLibCheck --types node benchmark/load-memory.spec.ts
scripts.benchmark:all: yarn benchmark && yarn benchmark:row-memo && node scripts/report.mjs --require-ablation && node --test scripts/report.test.mjs
scripts.build:row-memo: ROW_MEMO_ABLATION=on yarn workspace @experiment/manual build && ROW_MEMO_ABLATION=off yarn workspace @experiment/manual build && ROW_MEMO_ABLATION=on yarn workspace @experiment/manual build:profile && ROW_MEMO_ABLATION=off yarn workspace @experiment/manual build:profile
scripts.typecheck:row-memo: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --jsx react-jsx --strict --skipLibCheck --types node,vite/client playwright.ablation.config.ts benchmark/row-ablation.spec.ts benchmark/row-ablation-order.ts
scripts.benchmark:row-memo: yarn fmt:check && yarn lint && node --test scripts/row-ablation-build.test.mjs scripts/row-ablation.test.mjs benchmark/row-ablation-order.test.mjs && yarn typecheck && yarn typecheck:row-memo && yarn build:row-memo && playwright test --config playwright.ablation.config.ts && node scripts/report-row-ablation.mjs && node --test scripts/row-ablation-report.test.mjs
scripts.analyze:compiler: react-compiler-analyzer analyze apps/compiler/src shared benchmark/recorder.tsx --format json
scripts.check:compiler-repros: yarn lint:compiler-repros && yarn typecheck:compiler-repros && yarn test:compiler-repros && yarn test:compiler-repros:browser && yarn build:compiler-repros && node scripts/check-pages.mjs --compiler-repros-only
scripts.typecheck:compiler-repros: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --jsx react-jsx --strict --skipLibCheck compiler-repros/cases/*.tsx
scripts.check:compiler-activity: oxlint compiler-activity && yarn test:compiler-activity && yarn build:compiler-activity && node scripts/check-pages.mjs --compiler-activity-only
